title: Placement
description: right/left = the empty space at that screen edge, beside the mania stage. stage-right/stage-left = against the stage itself (uses Column start/width below). columns = one thin strip under each real stage column at the bottom of the screen (set Column start/width to your skin's).

title: Horizontal nudge / px
description: Moves the overlay right (+) or left (−) from its placement.

title: Vertical nudge / px
description: Moves the overlay down (+) or up (−) from its placement.

title: Scale
description: 0.5–2. Not applied in the columns placement, which follows the stage.

title: Column start (skin.ini)
description: Your skin's ColumnStart for this key count (osu!stable default 136). Only used by the stage-* and columns placements; lazer centres the stage.

title: Column width (skin.ini)
description: Your skin's ColumnWidth for this key count (default 30). Only used by the stage-* and columns placements.

title: Tick lifetime / s
description: How long a fresh hit tick stays bright before fading into the column's accumulated distribution. 0.5–30 s.

title: Hold release row
description: Per-column timing of osu!mania hold (LN) releases, on 1.5× release windows. auto = only on maps with holds.

title: Show numbers
description: Per-column mean (ms, − early / + late) and UR under the strips. Hidden automatically above 10 keys.

title: Backing
description: none = floats on the game; scrim = a soft fading shade behind it; panel = a graphite panel.

title: Highlight colour
description: Colour of the highest-UR callout: a tone from the current map's background, or 18-LAB amber. Early/late and judgement colours never change.
